create_AffiliateMarketing: create an AffiliateMarketing instance with an affiliate link, firefox profile path, twitter account uuid, nickname, and topic
scrape_product_information: scrape product title and feature bullets from an Amazon affiliate link using a headless Firefox browser
generate_pitch: generate a product promotion pitch with title, features, and affiliate link using the LLM

generate_response: generate an LLM response from a given prompt string using the configured text generation provider
